name: foodhub-monorepo
description: FoodHub - Premium Restaurant Ordering & Real-Time Delivery Tracking Platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @foodhub/shared && npm run build -w @foodhub/api && npm run build -w @foodhub/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @foodhub/shared && npm run test -w @foodhub/api && npm run test -w @foodhub/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @foodhub/api && npm run lint -w @foodhub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @foodhub/shared && npm run typecheck -w @foodhub/api && npm run typecheck -w @foodhub/web
